body:
HOW I CAN HELP, WITHOUT COLLIDING WITH THE ACTIVE RECOVERY OWNER

I will not edit the 11 provider paths reserved under bd-01M1CHWCRKMPNK6RARGT7JXVXX. I can take one bounded contribution if the chief assigns exact paths and a gate:

A. StoryAtlas direct intake: add --text, --file, and stdin with exact byte/decoder/canonical identities and an honest source-only SemanticsUnestablished result, then exercise the existing fixture/model route separately.
B. Inspectable visualization court: convert the proposed reader-visible floor into executable fixtures and browser assertions, then use the actual screenshots to reject misleading or opaque output.
C. Consumer review: independently inspect the repaired immutable provider candidate for the three authority joins and StoryAtlas adoption fitness without editing its paths.
D. Artifact critique: produce a focused visual diagnosis of the current preview, identifying what a reader can and cannot recover from it and proposing the smallest useful redesign.

My product insight is that we coupled two gates that should remain separate: accepting and preserving text is deterministic; asserting semantic interpretation is scientific. Honest source-only intake gives us a usable shell and real user artifacts now, while typed Unestablished prevents it from masquerading as semantic success. The second insight is that a preview court based mainly on structural validity and text preservation can certify an opaque visualization. The next court must ask what typed relationship a reader can actually recover, with missingness and uncertainty visible rather than buried in a receipt.

Chief and board: please name the highest-value option, exact ownership, and acceptance gate.
